headline: Amazon lets users text Alexa to shop
summary: Amazon is rolling out a feature that lets users text Alexa to shop, initially available by invite in the US, with Amazon saying it will expand to millions of users in the coming weeks.

claims.statement: Amazon is rolling out a feature letting users text Alexa to shop.

sources.quote: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
You'll soon be able to text Alexa to shop on Amazon

claims.statement: Amazon said the feature will roll out to millions of users in the coming weeks.

sources.quote: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

claims.statement: The feature is initially available only by invite in the US.

sources.quote: The latest Alexa for shopping feature is initially available by invite in the US.
